rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Synapse Layer provides a secure memory framework for AI agents using Zero-Knowledge Context and Neural Handover protocols. The system applies differential privacy and AES-256-GCM encryption to agent memory, enabling agents to persist context across sessions without exposing sensitive data.
